item.title: SCP Idea: Stuck in the Past
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Basically, it's a set of three anomalous access dial-up Internet access numbers, each with the same anomalous property: when you connect to it, your web browser is pretty much transported back to the late 2000s. Everything is as it was back then: web sites, web services, social media are all unchanged from their original forms back then, and it can all be interacted with by users of this SCP. For all intents and purposes, this SCP is a type of time machine.

Central Narrative: The Foundation discovers the existence of this SCP in 2017, and a few years later they use it to interview some people from the past. Through these interviews, they discover the possible origin of the SCP, and eventually they find one of its' creators. He explains how it was made and why it was made (making reference to an unnamed made-up SCP with time and reality manipulation powers which the foundation has not yet contained, cuz im too lazy to find an existing SCP matching those criteria :P)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: There are many internet-based SCPs, but I have yet to see one which is directly affiliated with the internet itself rather than just using it as a medium through which to do its "thing". The internet is a big and scary place, and I feel like its many different subcultures and groups (and its history) have so much potential as a source of inspiration for SCPs. After all, without the internet, the Foundation wouldn't exist ;)

Additional Notes: I've already typed up a draft of the entire article + the chat/interview logs, if you want me to post it here I can.

Thanks for reading my idea, everyone! This is my second real SCP idea that I've posted here, and it's the first one that I'm really, truly super proud of ^u^ It's been such a long time, I honestly forgot how much I love writing…
